notes.title: Diesel Legacy: Public Playtest 2 Guide
notes.content:
[h1]PUBLIC PLAYTEST 2 GUIDE[/h1]

[h2]TIMES: DECEMBER 13TH @ 10:00AM PT - JANUARY 3RD @ 11:59PM PT[/h2]

[i]Note: We may have to perform emergency maintenance if issues occur during the beta. Follow Diesel Legacy on Steam or other social media to be informed when these periods may occur.[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1959140/Diesel_Legacy_The_Brazen_Age/

We’re almost ready to open the gates to the Iron City once again! We’ve missed you! Once the playtest starts soon, we’ll be happy to show off a ton more content, characters and gameplay tweaks.

The purpose of this playtest is to build off last round’s feedback– for characters, RealMatch rollback netcode, lobbies and much more! You’ll be able to play with anyone in the world, so feel free to invite whoever– wherever they are, and start brawling for supremacy!

[h2]TABLE OF CONTENTS[/h2]
[list]
[*] Content Available
[*] How To Play
[*] Menu Navigation
[*] New Characters
[*] New Co-Op Mechanics
[*] Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
[/list]

[h2]CONTENT AVAILABLE[/h2]

[b]Characters[/b]
[list]
[*] [i](NEW)[/i] Eleanora
[*] [i](NEW)[/i] Nyra
[*] Rory
[*] Ruby
[*] Fritz
[*] Rotwang
[/list]
[b]Stages[/b]
[list]
[*] [i](NEW)[/i] 16 Stages
[/list]
[b]Modes[/b]
[list]
[*] [i](NEW)[/i] Free-For-All Versus Mode [Online / Offline]
[*] [i](NEW)[/i] Enhanced Meet-Up / Lobbies
[*] [i](NEW)[/i] Enhanced How To Play / Button Check
[*] [i](NEW)[/i] Stats/Leaderboards
[*] 2v2 Teams Versus Mode [Online / Offline]
[*] Training Mode [Online / Offline]
[*] Replays
[*] Live Spectator Mode
[/list]
[b]Co-Op System Mechanics[/b]
[list]
[*] [i](NEW)[/i] Jive Bomber
[*] [i](NEW)[/i] Switcheroo
[/list]
[b]Co-Op Post K.O. Mechanics[/b]
[list]
[*] [i](NEW)[/i] Ghost Meter
[*] [i](NEW)[/i] Ghost Jive Bomber
[*] [i](NEW)[/i] Ghost Vengeance
[*] Ghost Guard [i](previously known as Ghost Parry)[/i]
[*] Ghost Buster [i](previously known as Ghost Shock)[/i]
[/list]
[b]NEW Miscellaneous Features[/b]
[list]
[*] UX/UI Overhaul
[*] Voice Communication with Block Functionality
[*] Stage Selection
[*] Stats/Leaderboards
[*] Full Audio Settings
[*] Custom Window-Size Support (including 16:10 monitor support)
[/list]
This list is only the beginning of what we’ve got to offer! Part of the Diesel Magic of Diesel Legacy is discovering all the depthful intricacies of the game– it’s time to jump in and find out what to explore!

[h2]HOW TO PLAY[/h2]

[previewyoutube=ZZ2wpxbCL5k;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]MENU NAVIGATION[/h2]

The “Juice Room” Main Menu is back, but upgraded!

[b]MEET UP[/b] - Use meet up to form a party from two to four players. Once your party is set, you can practice in training, fight against CPUs or queue together against other live players in Teams or Free-For-All online versus.

[b]TRAINING[/b] - Put in some lab work! Get used to any characters and explore the vast training options to become the ultimate Iron City contender. (Up to two players can play.)

[b]ONLINE[/b] - Choose Teams or Free-For-All and get matched against anyone in the world!

[b]SPECTATOR MODE / REPLAYS[/b] - Watch any live match or any match in the past– you can even take control of any character in any match to learn from your mistakes!

[b]STATS[/b] - Want to know how you stack up against the rest of the world? Check out our beta stats and see how close you are to being number one!

[h2]NEW CHARACTERS[/h2]

[h3]Eleanora[/h3]
[b]The Gun-Toting Mob Boss Dressed to Kill[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44089195/a4f15af23e3dc235498e3432f537f3d6ffab061e.gif[/img]

[b]CHARACTER ARCHETYPE[/b] - Heavy Zoning / Lane Control / Henchmen
[b]QUICK BIO[/b] - Always with style, she’s gonna be the biggest and baddest “wiseguy” this town’s ever seen, but she and the boys prefer to fight dirty.

[h3]Nyra[/h3]
[b]Her Inner Peace Belies Outer Ferocity[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44089195/35e09e95e90f86f3a437e13547c05ff3c63e8925.gif[/img]

[b]CHARACTER ARCHETYPE[/b] - Hybrid Chain Grappler / Long Reach
[b]QUICK BIO[/b] - A skillful and agile practitioner of an ancient grappling art, Nyra is also the wielder of a peculiar set of extra limbs that bonded to her from her home village’s shrine.

[i]A quick breakdown of both of these characters will be released over the next coming weeks. Keep your eyes peeled![/i]

[h2]NEW CO-OP MECHANICS[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Jive Bomber[/b] - [i]C+D (while teammate is not jumping or being hit, 25% meter)[/i]: Teleport to your teammate and perform an invincible attack!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44089195/5ba843c2e344347c91a265c499ed1aa2577c597d.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44089195/5ba843c2e344347c91a265c499ed1aa2577c597d.gif[/img][/url]

[*] [b]Switcheroo[/b] - [i]C+D (while teammate is being hit or grabbed, 25% meter)[/i]: Instantly take your teammate’s place to allow them to escape!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44089195/111ca4209bd9ec2af31fbbff2970dac12eafedbf.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44089195/111ca4209bd9ec2af31fbbff2970dac12eafedbf.gif[/img][/url]

[*] [b]Ghost Meter[/b] - [i]Upon K.O. in Teams, you’re given a full ghost meter![/i] 1) Performing Ghost Assist/Jive Bomber/Shock will cost meter, while successful Ghost Parries will add meter. 2) Your ghost meter will automatically replenish. 3) Losing all your ghost meter will take you out of the rest of the round, so use your resources carefully!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44089195/3b4dea4f0af804492f4b018f2b69e723b9d2bbc0.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44089195/3b4dea4f0af804492f4b018f2b69e723b9d2bbc0.gif[/img][/url]

[*] [b]Ghost Vengeance[/b] - [i]Input any special move (as a ghost, while teammate is not blocking or being hit, 12.5% ghost meter)[/i]: Perform any special attack as a ghost, next to your teammate!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44089195/34e56c2fcabd263fd696f341504a2a56f4826ab5.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44089195/34e56c2fcabd263fd696f341504a2a56f4826ab5.gif[/img][/url]

[*] [b]Ghost Jive Bomber[/b] - [i]C+D (as a ghost, when teammate is grounded and not being hit, 33% ghost meter)[/i] - Teleport to your teammate and perform an invincible ghost attack!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44089195/096d32baf15be25ca95da93078a321bdca6a70ce.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44089195/096d32baf15be25ca95da93078a321bdca6a70ce.gif[/img][/url][/list]


[h2]Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)[/h2]

[b]Q1) When does the 2nd playtest start and end?[/b]
A1) The playtest starts on December 13th @ 10:00 AM PT and ends on January 3rd @ 11:59 PM PT.

[b]Q2) Who can sign up for the playtest?[/b]
A2) Everyone on Steam can join and contribute!

[b]Q3) How do I sign up for the playtest?[/b]
A3) Just download the playtest from the Steam Store page and you’ll be able to join!

[b]Q4) What are the minimum system specs needed to play?[/b]
A4)
[list]
[*] OS: Windows 7 (64bit)
[*] Processor: Intel Core i5-7500 | AMD Ryzen 2600
[*] Graphics: GTX 970 / RX 570
[*] DirectX: Version 11
[/list]

[b]Q5) I found a bug / I have a question / I have a great suggestion! Where can I talk about it?[/b]
A5) You can drop off any feedback on our official Discord, found here [https://discord.gg/qZczTqaXsr]

[b]Q6) Where can I hang out with the community and find out about upcoming events and keep up with future updates?[/b]
A6) Everyone’s welcome in our official Discord– feel free to check us out on social media too!
Discord: [https://discord.gg/qZczTqaXsr]
X (formerly known as Twitter): [https://twitter.com/DieselLegacy]
Instagram: [https://instagram.com/DieselLegacyGame]
Facebook: [https://facebook.com/DieselLegacy]

As always, let us know your feedback or just join the Iron City community on our official Discord! See you on the battlefield soon. 🫡

Cheers,
The Diesel Legacy Team

notes.title: Diesel Legacy Open Beta Update #1
notes.content:
[list][*]Pressing F1 will now turn off the music.
[*]Added a macro button for B+D together, defaulted to Left Trigger. If you’ve already mapped your buttons before this patch you must manually map this button.
[*]Fixed matchmaking for 2-person Meetup teams in Online.
[*]Fixed a disconnection issue at match start that could result in lopsided 2v1 online matches. This might return as a feature!
[*]If the game fails to establish a connection to anyone in an online match when joining, that group is now ignored when continuing the search until a match is successfully joined.
[*]Rory’s Thermal Fatigue can properly change lanes when holding down the Throw macro button, rather than requiring the A+B buttons specifically.
[*]Made Ruby’s standing collision slightly taller so Rotwang can’t fly over her at his lowest height. Ensured existing crossups still work on her.
[*]Entering Training Mode correctly keeps your chosen color.
[*]Fixed “Login Failed” for usernames shorter than 3 characters.
[*]Fixed errors in General, Ruby, and Fritz move lists.
[/list]

Please update the build before attempting to connect online - all players will need to be on the same client version in order to play together.

Thanks to everyone playing and everyone reporting bugs!
- The Diesel Legacy Team
